finding: The initial reader scanned only top-level written_run segments. Its quotation segments were opaque, so it would omit the frozen exact-shape observation inside a quotation.
contract_decision: Exact written shape observations inside quotation are in scope; they confer no use, word class, role, actual case or temporal attachment.
implementation_correction: The implementation owner added quoted inner written runs with original-source UTF-8 byte spans, explicit MENTION context and the containing quotation span. Future proposals consume UNQUOTED occurrences only.
adapter_correction: The reviewer adapter now validates all top-level unquoted runs and permits ordered, non-overlapping mentioned runs only inside their original quoted container. This changes schema handling, not the frozen input, required candidate or exclusion.
old_runtime_snapshot_note: No runtime evaluation had occurred before this static review correction; no old performance result is claimed.
additional_test_scope: Post-open integrity regression verifies that a quoted shape witness cannot be relabeled an unquoted use; it does not enlarge the 96 frozen cases.
